tagline.en_US: VLC Media Player is a free and open source cross-platform multimedia player and framework that delivers dependable performance across multiple devices.

description.en_US: VLC Media Player is a free and open-source multimedia player and framework designed to handle audio and video playback. It supports a wide variety of multimedia formats and network streaming protocols across multiple platforms. Delivered through an interactive browser desktop interface, it enables users to play back and control media remotely.
